title: A name and a claim

captions.instagram:
Nobody Beats The Wiz. Four words, and one of the most memorable electronics brands in the New York region.

My father named it after his favorite Broadway musical. The marketing pillars behind it: memorable naming, clear positioning, market visibility and brand consistency.

captions.linkedin:
A name can carry a promise if the business keeps it.

Nobody Beats The Wiz was named after my father's favorite Broadway musical, and it became one of the most memorable electronics brands in the New York region.

Four marketing pillars sat behind it: memorable naming, clear positioning, market visibility and brand consistency.

The test I'd run on any brand: Is the name easy to remember? Is the promise clear? Do people see it often? Is it the same everywhere?
